originality.rationale: García-Ramos–Pavlov Theorem 3.19 determines a single S-gap MME marker probability exactly. The inspected Chazottes–Ramirez–Ugalde Gibbs approximation theorem establishes exponential convergence but not a sharp cover-difference marker-frequency n q^n error or its periodic coefficient. Coles et al. define qualitative entropy stabilization. Published geometric-gap covers give entropy-only phases for a disjoint nonsofic family, not MME marginal rates. No decisive broader implication found; prior specialized calculations remain possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed specialized renewal-theory or information-theory papers could independently calculate an equivalent exact coefficient.
Generic exponential Gibbs convergence cannot be inverted to give this sharp constant, but fuller historical priority assessment remains appropriate.
